facts.fact: UNDP Rwanda, with the Rwanda Cultural Heritage Academy, tendered a consultancy (RFP UNDP-RWA-00409, published 18 Aug 2026) to prepare AI-ready Kinyarwanda text and speech datasets and a secure digital repository.

systems.system: Kinyarwanda AI-ready text and speech datasets
